scope: Every article and each of its twelve full-language URLs; applies to the one-recommendation plus one-buying-guide batch.
objective: All intended-publication pages must meet applicable Google Search requirements and project quality checks. Actual crawling, indexing and ranking are measured outcomes, not guaranteed by a draft or test pass.

requirements: Check the target site's actual URLs, existing articles and pending drafts for duplicate search intent.
Define a specific overseas buyer task; recommendations and buying guides must have distinct useful purposes.
Extract facts from exact source pages and add original, evidence-bound buyer analysis rather than copying, stitching or merely translating third-party articles.
Match model year, market, trim, powertrain, units and test cycle; no fabricated prices, stock, warranty, driving experience or universal export eligibility.
Use natural language and descriptive titles/headings; avoid keyword stuffing and repeated article templates.
Project word/source-count thresholds are editorial controls, not Google's indexing requirements.
Each locale has a separate stable URL and complete natural-language body, metadata, tables, FAQ, sources and appropriate image text.
Review semantic quality, numbers and fact scope in every locale; metadata-only translation is incomplete.
Validate hreflang codes, self/alternate entries and reciprocal links; canonical signals must identify the intended page without incorrectly consolidating distinct language versions into English.
Verify the actual deployed URL returns HTTP 200 and exposes the approved substantive content to crawlers.
Verify intended-publication URLs have no unintended crawler block, noindex/X-Robots-Tag, login wall, redirect loop or soft 404.
Check canonical, relevant crawlable internal links, sitemap inclusion and correct language mapping.
Check mobile rendering, broken resources and page usability; structured data must match visible truthful content and applicable Google policies.
Do not remove quality-hold noindex from existing pages merely to increase the indexed count.
Use the correct autobridgetrade.top Search Console property and per-URL evidence to record discovery/crawl/index state, Google-selected canonical and indexing reasons.
Track impressions, clicks and query relevance separately from index eligibility and actual indexed status.
For eligible pages not indexed, diagnose the specific content, duplication, access or canonical cause; repair failures while preserving clean pages.
Do not call publication, sitemap submission, request indexing, machine QA or HTTP 200 proof of actual Google indexing.

note: Acceptance requirements only. Recording this specification does not implement the gates or certify any existing/new page. No website settings, article versions, CURRENT pointers or existing workflows are modified.
